content.text: {"id": "mm5132a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Of 1,656 children aged 5--15 years included in the survey, 64 (4.2%) (95% confidence interval [CI]=2.9%--5.5%) walked to school"}, {"loc": "ocr", "q": "Percentage of children aged 5—15 years who lived"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "775 (48.9%) (95% CI=45.7%--52.1%) rode a school bus"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Of the 315 (19.0%) children who lived < 1 mile from school, 56 (18.6%; 95% CI=12.8%--24.4%) walked to school"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Older children were more likely to walk to school than younger children"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the proportion of children's trips to school < 1 mile made by walking from 31% to 50%"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "a statewide, representative, random-digit--dialed telephone survey of Georgia households with children"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Weighted percentages were obtained using by SAS and SUDAAN."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "these comparisons and those between sexes and between urban and rural residents were not statistically significant"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
